d: Explore Matera, one of the oldest cities in the world and a UNESCO World Heritage site, on our full-day trip through the stunning Sassi di Matera cave dwellings, panoramic viewpoints, and ancient rupestrian churches like Santa Maria di Idris and San Pietro Barisano. We’ll walk across the Gravina canyon into Murgia Materana Park, visit the Matera Cathedral, and step inside traditional cave houses and museums. Along the way, we enjoy local specialties such as the famous Pane di Matera, cruschi peppers, and regional wines at cozy osterias. To top it off, we stay in a unique cave hotel with…
